verdict.rationale: Lithic documents creating virtual cards via API and attaching card-level controls: Authorization Rules on MCC, country and currency, transaction and velocity limits, and spend limits. Together these give coarse per-card scoping. There is no evidence of a single-use card type, locking a card to one specific merchant, or an exact-amount authorization. Custom ASA decisioning is only a building block a developer would have to wire up, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented single-use card type that closes after one purchase, merchant-locked cards bound to one merchant, exact-amount restriction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
